|-- Placement and connection invariants
|   |-- lineGrid.ts: scene = content table + GridBox tree
|   |   |-- Diagram box references contentId; containers own child placements
|   |   |-- duplicate-instance -> another placement of the same content
|   |   |-- Grid movement uses cells; floating movement uses finite pixel coordinates
|   |   |-- layoutScene anchors changed subtree at each ancestor
|   |   |   `-- Settle siblings in stable spatial order, pushing only right
|   |   `-- Validate printable ASCII, bounds and non-overlap before publication
|   |       `-- Extent limit 20000; composed canvas limit 4000000 cells
|   `-- diagramConnection.ts: source content node -> target content node or box
|       |-- New or changed content endpoints must match current revision and node
|       |-- Existing unchanged endpoints may remain explicitly stale
|       |-- Unique connection IDs; at most 2000 edges
|       `-- Reconcile after scene changes
|           |-- Deleted endpoint placement -> remove incident edge
|           |-- Proven node mapping -> rebase endpoint to new revision
|           |-- Unchanged text + structure -> match node position

|-- History ownership: CanvasHistoryService -> CanvasHistory
|   |-- Runtime CanvasEditingContext handle -> isolated history in a WeakMap
|   |   `-- Two viewers can share persisted contextId without sharing mutable history
|   |-- StoredCanvasSnapshot separates three concerns
|   |   |-- diagramBindings: diagram/content ID -> exact diagram revision ID
|   |   |   `-- Diagram payloads live in the revision table, never inside scene composition
|   |   |-- document: GridBox root, edges, sections, jumps and semantic settings
|   |   |   `-- Includes contexts, alternatives, selections and revision reviews
|   |   `-- view: separately captured personal canvas state
|   |-- Checkpoint identity and correspondence
|   |   |-- id + parentId record checkpoint ancestry
|   |   |-- nodeOrigins retain correspondence to baseline nodes
|   |   `-- Canonical edge anchors use logical node references
|   |       `-- Legacy unresolved anchors retain their original stale endpoints
|   |-- append(document, view, correspondence)
|   |   |-- Validate scene, connections, contexts and revision dependencies
|   |   |-- Retain exact bound revisions and referenced alternatives/reviews/selections
|   |   `-- Store checkpoint -> push previous head to past -> set head -> clear future
|   `-- documentFromHistory(checkpointId)
|       `-- Resolve pinned revisions + decode anchors -> rendering/transport read model
|-- Undo, reset and proposal branches
|   |-- Live canvas: editor driver handles undo/redo
|   |   `-- restoreEditorCheckpoint navigates archived checkpoints without creating an edit
|   |-- Headless context: historyService.navigate(redo)
|   |   |-- Undo: past -> head; previous head -> future
|   |   |-- Redo: future -> head; previous head -> past
|   |   `-- Validate target, then restore document + personal view
|   |-- reset -> fresh checkpoint containing baseline state; reset itself is undoable
|   |-- forkContext -> new context and baseline; empty past/future
|   |   `-- Retain revision archive; remove active recording
|   `-- adopt(proposed history)
|       `-- Validate immutable revisions -> publish reviewed state as one checkpoint
|           `-- Preserve exact proposed diagram revision IDs
|-- Named CanvasViews: metadata outside undo-restored state
|   |-- Create/save -> pin checkpoint endpoints; start/stop -> record visited checkpoints
|   |-- Open -> stash working copy, restore target as fresh checkpoint, keep current camera
|   |-- Apply -> restore saved state as fresh checkpoint
|   |   `-- Omit original transfer transaction link; do not replay transfer
|   |-- Fork / alternatives -> child views pinned to parent's saved endpoint
|   |   |-- Keep -> save chosen alternative, archive siblings and their descendants
|   |   `-- Discard -> archive branch and descendants
|   |-- Compare -> read only pinned start/final endpoints and their revision dependencies
|   |   `-- Promote diffs -> alternatives with a new saved endpoint; preserve comparison base
|   |-- Generation -> candidates start from saved parent or supplied pinned history
|   |   `-- Finished proposal updates candidate endpoint without moving live head
|   `-- Dirty check compares document, bindings and view excluding viewport/selection
|-- Cross-canvas transfer: canvasTransfer.ts
|   |-- Prepare on isolated histories; workspace owns publication
|   |   `-- Require distinct canvases and a nonempty, unique selection of whole diagrams
|   |-- Copy
|   |   |-- Fresh placement/content identities; preserve relative arrangement
|   |   |-- Copy internal edges with remapped endpoints and fresh edge IDs
|   |   `-- Source history stays unchanged; destination checkpoint gets transaction link
|   |-- Move
|   |   |-- Preserve identities where destination has no collision
|   |   |-- Remove selected placements and unused source contents
|   |   |-- Convert source edges to jumps; remap links to moved targets
|   |   `-- Source and destination checkpoints share transaction ID
|   `-- Coordinated undo/redo
|       |-- Both heads must equal transaction's expected before/after boundaries
|       |-- Newer edits -> reject until both canvases reach the boundary
|       `-- Navigate destination, plus source for move; update transaction.applied
